name: movie-collection
description: Box office collection of films worldwide, built from free open data (Wikidata, Wikipedia).

scripts.fetch: node scripts/fetch-wikidata.mjs && node scripts/fetch-wikipedia.mjs && node scripts/fetch-history.mjs && node scripts/fetch-lists.mjs && node scripts/fetch-rates.mjs && node scripts/fetch-cpi.mjs && node scripts/fetch-worldwide-chart.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ratings.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/merge.mjs && npm run fetch:art && next build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.fetch:art: node scripts/fetch-posters.mjs && node scripts/fetch-people.mjs && node scripts/fetch-boxoffice.mjs && node scripts/fetch-cpi.mjs --if-missing
scripts.update: npm run fetch && npm run build
